name: Export Deliverable
description: Export the requested supported format and verify the destination artifact.

permissionsRequired.reason: Persist the document through the registered document tool.
Read the artifact back by the id the tool returned.
Persist a ZIP of only the requested files.
Read the persisted document back as text.
Read a source file that is already in the project.

validation.rule: The requested format was persisted and artifact_get confirmed the destination type with size greater than 0.
